name: Wreathlit Noel
source: A mysterious girl Tatsuya meets from time on time around the city. Doesn't speak much and doesn't seem to like dealing with people, though Tatsuya managed to convince her of eating in Trattoria Samon. Has a weakness for Sayaka. Tatsuya's dogs have an unusual affection for her. [spoiler]Is actually the vessel for [url=/c12784]Fiacca Marguerite[/url].[/spoiler]
